Hannah Green: Hey folks — first day! Running into a blocker: our GHA job needs to toggle a staging flag during PR setup but I don't have Console perms. Who do I ping for a short-lived CI service account?
Devin O'Neill: Welcome Hannah :wave: For CI flips we usually provision a service account with a Vault-backed token. Staging-only role is `feature_flag_manager` (scoped).
Hannah Green: Sweet. Is there a self-serve request or should I file an access ticket?
access-bot: Hi Hannah — please use https://redwood.internal/access-requests. Select "Console service account (staging)" and include manager approval. Typical expiry: 30 days for CI tokens.
Kara Liu: Quick tip — if the job can use `ff-test/*` namespace, that avoids role escalation. Those flags are ephemeral and test-scoped.
Hannah Green: The job currently flips `experiments/model-serve-canary`. I can change it to `ff-test/model-serve-canary` if that's fine.
Devin O'Neill: If you can move to `ff-test/*` do that first. If you need persistent state across jobs, request the SA and include the exact flag keys and job name in the form.
Hannah Green: Ok submitting request now. Also can I get an example GHA snippet for using the Vault token?
Samir Khan: I'll handle the SA creation after infra approval. We store tokens in HashiCorp Vault and give you a path. GHA example: ```yaml
- name: Get console token
  run: echo "::add-mask::$TOKEN"
  env:
    TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VAULT_CONSOLE_TOKEN }}
- name: Flip flag
  run: curl -X POST https://console-staging.internal/api/v1/flags/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"experiments/model-serve-canary","value":true}'
```
Hannah Green: Nice — thanks. Submitted: https://redwood.internal/access-requests/req-2026-789. Justification: "CI PR smoke needs to toggle staging canary flag to validate model infra changes". Requested 30d expiry.
infra-bot: Draft Vault path registered at secret/data/ci/console/sa-2026-789 (awaiting token upload).
Samir Khan: I'll attach a minimal policy `console-ci-flag-flipper` with `console.flags.write` and org scope = staging. ETA ~48 hours to upload token and post Vault path.
Devin O'Neill: FYI forks can't access repo secrets in our GHA setup. Gate the flag flip to run only on branch builds or on the main repo.
Hannah Green: Thanks — will gate to branch builds. Devin, I added you as manager approver on the form.
Devin O'Neill: Approved. :white_check_mark:
Samir Khan: Received approval. Will upload token and post the Vault secret path here once complete.
Hannah Green: Amazing, thank you all! If anyone has 10m later to show the Console admin panel and `ff-test/*` behavior I'd appreciate it.
Kara Liu: I can do 10m at 3:30pm PT to walk through flags.
Hannah Green: 3:30pm PT works for me — thanks again!
